claim: `MeasurePreserving.map_of_comp` assumes `hf : Measurable f`, but the proof only needs `f` to be a.e.-measurable with respect to `μa`; the underlying measure identity is already available as `AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable`. Keeping the stronger measurability hypothesis makes this basic pushforward lemma less reusable than the measure API supports.
requested_change: Weaken the last hypothesis to `(hf : AEMeasurable f μa)`, prove the map equality with `AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hg.aemeasurable hf`, and update the downstream call in `MeasurePreserving.of_semiconj` to pass `hfm.aemeasurable`.
